building_name: Hicks Library / John W. Hicks Undergraduate Library
scope: Exterior research only; no modeling. Source claims are limited to their phase and view.

sources.title: Purdue BuildingShapesZip4 live FID 197
sources.method: Reprojected the 20-vertex ring to EPSG:26916, calculated approximate plan area/perimeter/bounds and compared to retained 2026-10-22 source snapshot.
sources.limits: IoU 1.0, Hausdorff 0 m against snapshot; source survey accuracy is undocumented. Raw Shape__Area/Length differ substantially from projected calculations and are not used.

sources.title: BuildingShapesZip4 schema
sources.limits: Vertical-looking GIS field units and semantics are not documented.

sources.title: Esri World Imagery; Indiana GIO source imagery
sources.resolution: Source 0.0762 m; cited source accuracy 0.15 m; 1200 px export across 292.48 m (~0.244 m/px resampled).
sources.limits: Overhead context cannot resolve facade openings, wall sections or small roof features; imagery predates the 2026 masonry work.

sources.title: Indiana Statewide 3DEP tile in2018_30001885_12
sources.source_crs: NAD83(HARN) / Indiana West (US survey foot) + NAVD88 height Geoid12B (US survey foot)
sources.method: Clipped the tile to the FID197 outline and summarized point classes / candidate heights relative to nearby ground returns.
sources.limits: Class 1 is unclassified and may include roof, facade, trees or other returns. Statistics are not measured roof or slope heights.

sources.title: West entrance to Hicks Undergraduate Library
sources.provider: Purdue Libraries and School of Information Studies News
sources.image_dimensions: 1200×1200 served; camera, photographer and capture date not stated.
sources.limits: Trees obscure edges; predates 2026 work; only the entrance side is labeled; exact opening count/dimensions unsupported. Image is referenced, not redistributed.

sources.title: Hicks exterior photograph
sources.provider: Purdue Department of Physics and Astronomy, Interactions Winter 2023
sources.method: Inspected existing audit copy: two adjoining sloped masonry faces and upper brick enclosure are visible.
sources.limits: Camera position/cardinal direction and scale unknown; capture date is not established.

sources.title: Board approval memo: Hicks masonry renovation
sources.provider: Purdue University Board of Trustees / Physical Facilities Committee
sources.method: Inspected the 2-page Purdue Board PDF in browser. It schedules mortar/sealant replacement and metal coverings over four sloped walls, construction May–August 2026.
sources.limits: Approval and schedule are not proof of completion or installed material.

sources.title: Indiana CHE Hicks Masonry Renovation project file
sources.provider: Indiana Commission for Higher Education / Purdue University
sources.method: Read project description and schedule on pages 46–48 and 50; occupancy/end listed September 2026.
sources.limits: Planned project scope only; no as-built drawings or completion confirmation.

sources.title: Hicks construction and Purdue Mall fountain photographs, MSP 215
sources.method: Indexed finding aid lists 132 exterior construction photographs from June 1980–October 1981.
sources.limits: Photographs themselves not retrieved or inspected; direct repository page was inaccessible to browser text retrieval.

sources.title: Office of Marketing and Media photographs, UA62 Box 90
sources.method: Finding-aid text identifies new-library exterior/contact-sheet images with landscape.
sources.limits: Contact sheets and negatives not inspected; directions and exact coverage unknown.

sources.title: Purdue Libraries FAQ: Hicks basement one level below ground
sources.provider: Purdue Libraries and School of Information Studies News
sources.method: Text identifies the basement as one level below the ground/underground library and lists two former IMPACT rooms.
sources.limits: Historic occupancy statement, not a current room plan or complete basement topology.

sources.title: Hicks renovation celebration
sources.method: Documents the completed ground-floor renovation and interior furniture categories.
sources.limits: Historical interior evidence only; not facade or current as-built room layout.

sources.title: Hicks Undergraduate Library renovation project feature
sources.provider: Association of College and Research Libraries / Purdue Libraries
sources.method: Searchable publication text names GMB Architecture + Engineering and August 2013 completion.
sources.limits: Interior-design publication; not as-built elevations or floor plans.

sources.title: Purdue Libraries Master Plan Volume 2
sources.limits: Strategic proposals are not as-built changes; no exterior face schedule established.

sources.title: Google Maps user-contributed panorama near Hicks Library
sources.method: Opened and inspected; image is an indoor study-space view.
sources.limits: Does not provide exterior coverage, camera position or current condition; image not redistributed.

sources.title: John W. Hicks Undergraduate Library Archives authority record
sources.method: Indexed description supports existence from 1982 and usage of Hicks name from 1989.
sources.limits: Page returned 403; some secondary accounts give a 1990 renaming date.
